criteria.name: Study Timeline

criteria.name: Protections for Human Subjects
criteria.quote: For research that involves human subjects but does not involve one of the categories of research that are exempt under 45 CFR Part 46

criteria.name: Inclusion of Women, Minorities, and Individuals Across the Lifespan
criteria.quote: When the proposed project involves human subjects and/or NIH-defined clinical research, the committee will evaluate the proposed plans for the inclusion (or exclusion)

criteria.name: Vertebrate Animals
criteria.quote: The committee will evaluate the involvement of live vertebrate animals as part of the scientific assessment

criteria.name: Biohazards
criteria.quote: Reviewers will assess whether materials or procedures proposed are potentially hazardous to research personnel and/or the environment

criteria.name: Resubmissions
criteria.quote: For Resubmissions, the committee will evaluate the application as now presented, taking into consideration the responses to comments

criteria.name: Revisions
criteria.quote: For Revisions, the committee will consider the appropriateness of the proposed expansion of the scope of the project.

criteria.name: Select Agent Research
criteria.quote: Reviewers will assess the information provided in this section of the application, including 1) the Select Agent(s) to be used in the proposed research

criteria.name: Resource Sharing Plans
criteria.quote: Reviewers will comment on whether the Resource Sharing Plan(s)

criteria.name: Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources
criteria.quote: For projects involving key biological and/or chemical resources, reviewers will comment on the brief plans proposed for identifying and ensuring the validity of those resources.

criteria.name: Budget and Period of Support
criteria.quote: Reviewers will consider whether the budget and the requested period of support are fully justified and reasonable in relation to the proposed research.

eligibility.item: Eligible organizations: public/state and private institutions of higher education; nonprofits with or without 501(c)(3) status; for-profit organizations including small businesses; state, county, city/township and special district governments; federally recognized and other tribal governments; eligible federal agencies; U.S. territories or possessions; independent school districts; public/Indian housing authorities; Native American tribal organizations; faith-based or community-based organizations; regional organizations
eligibility.quote: Nonprofits with 501(c)(3) IRS Status (Other than Institutions of Higher Education)

eligibility.item: A graduate school accredited to award higher degrees related to clinical or translational science must be included as the applicant or a partnering institution
eligibility.quote: a graduate school accredited to award higher degrees related to clinical or translational science (e.g., M.S. or Ph.D. in topics such as Clinical Research, Public Health, Pharmacology, Nursing, Informatics, Health Economics, or Epidemiology) must be included (applicant or partnering institution)

eligibility.item: Organizations with active grants under PAR-15-304, PAR-18-464, PAR-18-940 or PAR-21-293 with more than 16 months of support remaining on the submission deadline are not eligible
eligibility.quote: that have more than 16 months of support remaining on the day of the submission deadline are not eligible to apply.

eligibility.item: A Partnering Institution may be a partner on only one CTSA UM1 hub application; applications including partners already on another UL1 or UM1 award or application are non-responsive
eligibility.quote: Applications that include Partner(s) which are already Partners on another UL1 award or UM1 award or application.

eligibility.item: An organization named as a Partner on a UM1 application or award or a UL1 award may not apply as the applicant organization while that application or award is under review, under consideration for funding, or funded
eligibility.quote: An organization named as a Partner Institution in a CTSA UM1 application, UM1 award, or a CTSA UL1 award

eligibility.item: Non-domestic (non-U.S.) entities and non-domestic components of U.S. organizations are not eligible to apply
eligibility.quote: Non-domestic (non-U.S.) Entities (Foreign Organizations) are not eligible to apply. Non-domestic (non-U.S.) components of U.S. Organizations are not eligible to apply.

eligibility.item: Foreign components, as defined in the NIH Grants Policy Statement, are allowed
eligibility.quote: Foreign components, as defined in the NIH Grants Policy Statement

eligibility.item: The application must be part of a collaborative set that includes the required companion K12 application (initially submitted concurrently with the UM1)
eligibility.quote: a set must contain 1 application to this UM1 NOFO and 1 application to the K12 NOFO

eligibility.item: Applications must answer Yes to the involvement of Human Subjects and complete all related sections
eligibility.quote: All applicants must answer Yes to the involvement of Human Subjects during the period of award and complete all related sections.

eligibility.item: Each PD/PI must commit at least two months effort (preferably three to six months)
eligibility.quote: All PD(s)/PI(s) must each commit at least two months and preferably three to six months effort to the award.

eligibility.item: The application must describe in detail a single initial, discrete Element E project with a detailed budget
eligibility.quote: Applications that do not describe, in detail, a single initial, discrete project for Element E including a detailed budget for the project described.

eligibility.item: Applications submitted as not having clinical trials that NIH determines do have clinical trials are non-responsive
eligibility.quote: Applications that are submitted as not having clinical trials, but NIH determines that there are clinical trials

eligibility.item: Clinical trials are optional
eligibility.quote: Optional: Accepting applications that either propose or do not propose clinical trial(s).

eligibility.item: Funds may not directly support clinical trials beyond Phase IIB, except Phase III trials for rare diseases; projects not meeting this will not be reviewed
eligibility.quote: Funds may not directly support any clinical trial beyond phase IIB with the exception of Phase III clinical trials for treatment of rare diseases. Projects that do not meet these clinical trial limitations will not be reviewed.

eligibility.item: Only New, Resubmission (for PAR-21-293 and this NOFO), or Revision application types are allowed
eligibility.quote: Resubmission - Resubmission Applications for PAR-21-293 and this NOFO

eligibility.item: The contact PD/PI must be designated as the Strategic Management Module Leader
eligibility.quote: The contact PD/PI must be designated as the Strategic Management Module Leader.

eligibility.item: UM1 PD(s)/PI(s) may not be PD(s)/PI(s) on the companion K12, T32, or R25 application or award (the RC2 is allowed)
eligibility.quote: The UM1 PD(s)/PI(s) may not be a PD(s)/PI(s) on the required companion K12 and/or the optional companion T32, and/or R25 application or award

eligibility.item: Any individual with the skills, knowledge, and resources to carry out the research may serve as PD/PI with their organization
eligibility.quote: Any individual(s) with the skills, knowledge, and resources necessary to carry out the proposed research as the

eligibility.item: Organizations may submit more than one application only if each is scientifically distinct
eligibility.quote: Applicant organizations may submit more than one application, provided that each application is scientifically distinct.

eligibility.item: A new (A0) application is not accepted before the summary statement issues for an overlapping A0 or A1 application
eligibility.quote: A new (A0) application that is submitted before issuance of the summary statement from the review of an overlapping new (A0) or resubmission (A1) application.

eligibility.item: A resubmission (A1) is not accepted before the summary statement issues for the previous A0 application
eligibility.quote: A resubmission (A1) application that is submitted before issuance of the summary statement from the review of the previous new (A0) application.

eligibility.item: An application substantially overlapping another application pending appeal of initial peer review is not accepted
eligibility.quote: An application that has substantial overlap with another application pending appeal of initial peer review

eligibility.item: All organizational registrations must be completed before the application is submitted (allow 6 weeks or more)
eligibility.quote: All registrations must be completed prior to the application being submitted. Registration can take 6 weeks or more

eligibility.item: Maintain an active SAM registration, renewed at least annually
eligibility.quote: Applicants must complete and maintain an active registration, which requires renewal at least annually.

eligibility.item: Foreign organizations must obtain an NCAGE code to register in SAM
eligibility.quote: NCAGE code (in lieu of a CAGE code) in order to register in SAM.

eligibility.item: Use the same UEI for all registrations and on the grant application
eligibility.quote: UEI must be used for all registrations, as well as on the grant application.

eligibility.item: Organization must register in eRA Commons with at least one Signing Official and one PD/PI account
eligibility.quote: Commons requires organizations to identify at least one Signing Official (SO) and at least one Program Director/Principal Investigator (PD/PI) account in order to submit an application.

eligibility.item: Organization must complete Grants.gov registration (requires active SAM registration)
eligibility.quote: Applicants must have an active SAM registration in order to complete the Grants.gov registration.

eligibility.item: All PD(s)/PI(s) must have an eRA Commons account affiliated with the applicant organization
eligibility.quote: All PD(s)/PI(s) must have an eRA Commons account. PD(s)/PI(s) should work with their organizational officials to

eligibility.item: A PD/PI who is also the organizational Signing Official must have two distinct eRA Commons accounts
eligibility.quote: If the PD/PI is also the organizational Signing Official, they must have two distinct eRA Commons accounts, one for each role.

eligibility.item: All PD(s)/PI(s) must enter their eRA Commons ID in the Credential field of the Senior/Key Person Profile form
eligibility.quote: All PD(s)/PI(s) must include their eRA Commons ID in the Credential field of the Senior/Key Person Profile form.
